headline: Check Tide Times and Car Park Availability Early
reservation: Entry to the park is generally open, but parking operates under a pay-and-display system. The two on-site lots fill quickly during peak periods, so visitors should plan for alternative parking or arrive via the A259 bus service. Always verify current parking fees and height restrictions at the official park website.

intel.title: On-site Lot Constraints
intel.text: The park features two pay and display car parks that fill quickly during peak season. Very limited alternative parking exists nearby, so public transport is recommended.

intel.text: Suggested times are itinerary choices. Check car-park opening and any height barriers on the official getting-here page before departure.

intel.title: River Crossing Hazards
intel.text: Do not attempt to cross the Cuckmere River at high tide due to dangerous currents. Stick to designated paths and kissing gates to navigate the livestock grazing areas.

plan.arrival: The official getting-here page describes the A259 approach at Exceat, two pay-and-display car parks and bus stops at the Visitor Centre. Check current services and parking access before departure.
plan.vehicle: The reviewed sources do not establish rental or motorhome suitability on every approach road. Check your provider, the actual roads and each site’s vehicle restrictions before departure.
